title: cleanCodeDiscovery
responsibility: Selects reviewable source files, separates unsupported paths and applies Git, sensitive-path, generated-source and configured exclusions.

inputs.name: discoverCleanCodeFiles.root
inputs.description: Repository directory used to make collected paths relative and run the bounded Git ignore probe.

inputs.name: discoverCleanCodeFiles.collected
inputs.description: Collected files and ignored artifact or symlink paths to classify for the Clean Code review.

inputs.name: discoverCleanCodeFiles.exclusions
inputs.description: Configured relative-path glob patterns excluded before source-extension selection.

inputs.name: matchesExclusion.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path being checked against the configured exclusion pattern.

inputs.name: matchesExclusion.pattern
inputs.description: Slash-normalized glob with *, ** or ? tokens, or a directory prefix ending in a slash.

outputs.name: discoverCleanCodeFiles
outputs.description: Sorted selected files, unsupported files and excluded paths with reasons; a failed Git probe contributes no Git exclusions.

outputs.name: matchesExclusion
outputs.description: Whether the relative path matches the glob or directory prefix.
